Title: Generate Bangla QR with minimal optional fields
Preconditions: The application is running with Bangla QR configuration (guid, signingKey, signatureLength) properly set.
Expected Result: Returns HTTP 200 OK with a JSON body containing qrData, signature, and crc fields, all non-empty strings.

Title: Generate Bangla QR with all optional fields populated
Preconditions: The application is running with Bangla QR configuration (guid, signingKey, signatureLength) properly set.
Expected Result: Returns HTTP 200 OK with a JSON body containing qrData, signature, and crc fields, all non-empty strings.
